text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas.
At the same time, however, it's precious time
for final adjustments ahead of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought about at least offering a little breather,
but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“—I absolutely won't chicken out today.
I won't chicken out today...!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All riiight...!
Trainer, I'm going in for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Nice Nature train with an intensity bordering on demonic even more than usual, I couldn't bring myself to suggest taking a breather...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thanks for the hard work!
I was super focused there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've got somewhere to be after this!
So I'm gonna vanish! *poof*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, I couldn't bring myself to call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, on the night of that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzzz... Beep)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
""Ah. Hello, Trainer?
It's me. The real one, not a scammer.""

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Hey, think you could come out for a bit right now?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, there you are.
Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... I mean, wearing a jersey or school uniform
on a night like this would be so boring.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, tonight's Christmas, right?
...So, that means...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I got a Christmas present
ready for you!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...It's nothing grand,
but I... think it's nothing weird either."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the present
was a simple, hand-knitted scarf.
It felt soft and comforting to the touch, warming my heart...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, my mom taught me and I made it properly,
so it should be sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The only thing is, I just can't wrap my head around the design no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If it's too flashy, it's not good for everyday use, but if it's too plain, it just looks tacky.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, while I was overthinking it all...
I ended up with no patterns or decorations at all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry I'm not acting very charming, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's plain, sturdy, and not cute at all, but...
Even so, do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, burning the midnight oil really paid off.
All's well that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me.
Speaking of "hot pot"...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I heard everyone from the shopping district is having a hot pot party tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All kinds of shops are chipping in with their own ingredients,
so there's no doubt it's gonna be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What do ya say?
Why don't we go tease them a bit too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I need to see everyone's faces and soak up
plenty of energy from them while I still can.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's-a go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Nice Nature and I enjoyed
a delicious hot pot in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, and then...
About what comes next—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, I'm fine, totally fine...
...is what I'd like to say, but man, it sure is chilly."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Forgetting my coat...
Man, what a total blunder on my part.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I pushed it too close to the wire trying to get into shape...
choice_data_list: Shall I walk you back to the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, that sucks!
After I finally worked up the courage!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait.
I went through all the trouble of getting a gate pass and everything!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How about we take things a bit slower... and go for a walk or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...This might be our last chance to have a quiet chat just the two of us before the Arima Kinen, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Is it... no good?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, then that means Trainer is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...No. On second thought, maybe I will borrow it.
Catching a cold right now would be really bad."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: In return, Trainer, please wear the scarf I gave you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wrapped the scarf around...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that looks great on you.
Trust Nature-san to pick such a nice color.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Please treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I think I'll have you
put a coat over me too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... So toasty warm.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's so warm...
...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I spent a relaxing
Christmas evening with Nice Nature...
